postgres.version: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Homebrew) on aarch64-apple-darwin25.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101), 64-bit
postgres.location: local (same machine as workers and harness)

paced.rateRule: 50% of the 8-worker median backlog throughput (2585.2 tasks/s) in this invocation, rounded down to a multiple of 100

backlog.description: fresh backlog: every READY row claimed once by concurrent independent sessions

churn.description: hot-row churn: many sessions repeatedly re-claiming a few rows across successive ownership generations

config.variants: worker-id reuse on odd scenarios; concurrent stale/successor completion on every other pair
